Name: Stronger You
Author: Krutonium
Description:
So what this mod does is it takes your various stats (Farming, Mining, Fishing, etc) and uses them to calculate new Health and Energy stats for you, and applies it at the start of each day. It preserves (mostly) the effects of going to sleep out of energy, and it ensures that the modified values are not saved to your save file - meaning if you remove it, your health and energy levels will return to their expected values.

It also has a config file that lets you set a multiplier (to make it easier) as well as a base value to add to both regardless of level. It also lets you turn off the mod without having to outright remove it.
